Official SNSP data remains lower. NGO Sabuesos Unidas: ~5,800 disappearances since Sep 2024. June 3: Culiacán records 10 homicides in one day; 30 in 72 hours — Army airlifts 90 Murciélagos. June 4: Defense Secretary + National Guard Commander emergency visit to Culiacán. June 5: FGR contradicts Sheinbaum on Interpol Red Notice for Rocha Moya. June 6: Two more targeted killings in Culiacán; Escuinapa enters 14th consecutive day of gunfire.
